title: The actual unit on a single object normalized in every integer degree
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories with chosen derived categories, let C have enough injectives, and let S:C→D be additive and preserve finite limits. For every integer n and object Y of C, define u_n as the canonical degree-n homology identification from S(Y) to H^n(single_n(S(Y))), followed by H^n of the actual bounded-below derived unit on single_n(Y), using the canonical mapped-single and quotient identifications. Let e_n be the explicit isomorphism from H^n(R⁺S(single_n(-))) to S given by shifting single_n to single_0[-n], commuting R⁺S with the shift, applying the homology shift isomorphism, the classical degree-zero comparison, and rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf. Then u_n(Y) followed by e_n(Y) is the identity on S(Y). The constructions use [lem-sbc-right-derived-single-unit-homology-comparison] and [lem-pc-single-homology-shift-comparison]; n may be negative.

source.place: 05TC (2), double truncation; 05TD (3), the left-exact degree-zero unit comparison, with canonical-map elaboration from the parent node.

proof.text: Generalize the already proved single/quotient inverse-shift and mapped-single inverse-shift calculations from natural numbers to integers as private proved helpers. Apply the CommShift equation of the actual unit and its naturality along the inverse single shift. Applying H^n and homology shift naturality gives the degree-zero unit, preceded by the homology shift of the source single object. All these steps are proved in Lean.

Use the single-object homology shift comparison to cancel the source single homology identifications. The remaining degree-zero unit is identified with toRightDerivedZero by the proved unit comparison. Its composite with rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf.hom is identity by Mathlib. This proves the asserted normalization, including n=0, negative n, zero objects and zero functors.

theorem rightDerivedPlusSingleUnitHomologyAt_comp_shiftIso (n : ℤ) (Y : C) :
    S.rightDerivedPlusSingleUnitHomologyAt n Y ≫
      (S.rightDerivedPlusSingleShiftIso n).hom.app Y = 𝟙 (S.obj Y)
